items.explanation: In Punjabi hospitality convention, a guest's first refusal is a politeness ritual rather than a real decline — the host is expected to insist. The behavioural cue (settling in comfortably) contradicts the literal 'no'.

cultural_markers: ritual refusal in hospitality; first 'no' is not a real no
metadata.authors_note: Culture-specific politeness implicature; literal reading of the refusal gives the wrong answer.

latin.context: Manager ne Harjit de purane boss nu phone kar ke puchheya, “Harjit kamm vich kiddan da hai?” Purane boss ne keha, “Bahut vadhiya banda hai ji, time te aa janda hai te sab naal changa bolda hai.”
latin.question: Purane boss de jawab toh ki matlab niklda hai?
options: Harjit da kamm bahut vadhiya hai
Harjit nu naukri toh kadhya gaya si
Harjit de kamm baare oh khaas changa nahi keh sakda
Purane boss da Harjit naal jhagda hoya si

answer.label: C
answer.text: Harjit de kamm baare oh khaas changa nahi keh sakda

gurmukhi.context: ਮੈਨੇਜਰ ਨੇ ਹਰਜੀਤ ਦੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਬੌਸ ਨੂੰ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਪੁੱਛਿਆ, “ਹਰਜੀਤ ਕੰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿੱਦਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੈ?” ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਬੌਸ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ, “ਬਹੁਤ ਵਧੀਆ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੀ, ਟਾਈਮ ਤੇ ਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਨਾਲ ਚੰਗਾ ਬੋਲਦਾ ਹੈ।”
gurmukhi.question: ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਬੌਸ ਦੇ ਜਵਾਬ ਤੋਂ ਕੀ ਮਤਲਬ ਨਿਕਲਦਾ ਹੈ?
options: ਹਰਜੀਤ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ ਬਹੁਤ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੈ
ਹਰਜੀਤ ਨੂੰ ਨੌਕਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਕੱਢਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ
ਹਰਜੀਤ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਬਾਰੇ ਉਹ ਖਾਸ ਚੰਗਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਦਾ
ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਬੌਸ ਦਾ ਹਰਜੀਤ ਨਾਲ ਝਗੜਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਸੀ

answer.label: C
answer.text: ਹਰਜੀਤ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਬਾਰੇ ਉਹ ਖਾਸ ਚੰਗਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਦਾ

english.context: A manager phoned Harjit's former boss and asked, “How is Harjit at his work?” The former boss said, “He's a very nice man, he comes on time and speaks well with everyone.”
english.question: What does the former boss's answer imply?
options: Harjit's work is excellent
Harjit was fired from the job
He cannot say anything particularly good about Harjit's work
The former boss had a conflict with Harjit

answer.label: C
answer.text: He cannot say anything particularly good about Harjit's work

items.explanation: Asked specifically about work quality, the reply covers only punctuality and demeanour. Withholding the relevant information while appearing cooperative implicates a negative assessment without ever stating one.

cultural_markers: indirect negative reference via selective praise
metadata.authors_note: Tests quantity-maxim reasoning where every literal statement is positive.
